title: 第11章 离开

content_zh:
他如一头蛮牛，撒丫狂奔，隆隆作响，地面出现道道裂缝，泥浆溅出几米高，远处鸟群惊飞，野兽逃窜！
深深的吸了口气，无天抱着受伤的手臂，在一旁冷眼观看，没有阻止，也没有出手，龙河奔进密林，注定羊入虎口，成为妖兽腹中食，这是他罪有应得，那里才是他的葬身之所。
地上的黑灰已被大雨洗净，只剩下一具具不完整的白骨，七零八落，洒在地上，无比的醒目，宛如在告诉世人，不久前这里发生了一场惨剧。
小天趴在他的肩上，湿漉漉的长舌卷起，舔他的脸庞，是在安慰。
“心若被困，天下处处是牢笼。心之所安，矮瓦斗室也是天堂。”
无天咕哝，他大概明白了龙河所做的这一切是为了什么，一朝欲望，没得到想要的东西，反成了不仁不义，不忠不孝的人，这都是贪欲作祟，害人害己！
暴风雨侵略！
村口，无天跪伏在地，泛着光芒的手，一把一把的刨着。三个时辰后，一个五丈大的深坑出现，这是他用手掘开坟墓，安葬全村人的墓地。
泪如雨下，他披头散发，抱起一具具白骨，一根根手骨，一条条腿骨，还有那洁白而瘆人，仿佛在诉说着怨恨的头骨，放在深坑之中。
他一瘸一拐，寻遍了每个角落，那怕是一片骨屑，也没有遗漏，全都放了进去。
他没有去分别男女，或谁是谁，这是村子的所有人，大伙都是一家人，葬一起无可厚非，没必要去区分！
最后，他依依不舍的将那具完整的白骨，轻轻的放了进去，泪如涌泉，心中无法割舍，养育他十六的爷爷，相处十六的村人，如今尘归尘，土归土，他心里难过。
“吼！！！”
这时候，后山中群兽咆哮，似惊涛拍岸，余音隆隆，林中古树摇曳，山石崩裂，四下激射，尘土飞扬。
尘土之间，数十头狰狞的妖兽围着龙河，它们血盆大口，獠牙泛厉光，撕扯着他的身躯，一块块肉被撕下，被吞食。
“砰”的一声，一头妖兽粉碎，血雾漫天飞，但妖兽实在太多，一拥而上，他被兽潮淹没，再挣扎也徒劳无功！
千里之外，火烈鸟极速翱翔，火世与刘燕傲立而上，衣衫猎猎作响，俯视苍莽大地。
突然，火世面色一白，嘴角竟有一缕血液溢出，阴沉了下去。
“师兄，你怎么了？”刘燕疑惑道。
火世不语，眺望远方极地，那里是一座万丈山峰，巍峨而恢宏，山壁如同被斧头劈成，平整光洁，远远一看，似一柄巨剑，耸入云霄，震撼人心！

山峰上，群殿棋布，气势辉煌，玉宇琼楼，扎于山壁，彰显着不凡。
白雾漫漫，瑞霞喷薄，精气浓郁，这里宛如仙山，人间净土。
“现在不是追查龙河死因的时候，令牌现世，需尽快告知父亲，请他定夺。”火世面沉如水，脚下轻跺，火烈鸟尖鸣，速度急骤飙升，化成一道火芒，向那山峰掠去。
“爷爷，各位村人，龙河已死，他罪有应得，丧于妖兽腹中，不久的将来，便轮到罪魁祸首。”
抔抔黄土，撒在白骨上，将这里渐渐覆盖，无天手在颤抖，心有太多不舍，有太多话想说，但喉哝似被莫名的物体堵住，说不出来，唯有血泪滴落，诉说悲哀！
随着最后一抔黄土洒下，白骨被彻底掩埋，活人已不存在，死人归于尘土，他三跪九叩，拜祭冤死的亡魂！
“天儿在此立誓，定斩火世刘燕人头，祭奠大家的亡灵，各位安息吧！”无天双拳紧握，嘎吱声不断传出，他的泪水没有了，因为已经流干，阐述着承诺。
最后他起身一拜，带着无尽的伤悲，转身离去，消失在后山之中。
这一战，无天的伤势颇为严重，手臂骨折，精气耗尽，内腑受创，他要进入后山中养伤。
很快，他寻找了一处洞穴，里面有一只山猿，见有人类想要霸占自己的老窝，它愤怒扑杀而来，但被小天咬破喉哝，倒地死亡。
接下来几天，无天始终盘坐在洞中，小天在外面猎食，提炼出精元，供他疗伤所用。
小天体型虽小，但攻击力着实不差，这片山脉中，没有任何妖兽是它对手，被一一残杀！

content_en:
He was like a wild bull, running wildly, rumbling, cracks appeared on the ground, mud splashed several meters high, birds flew away in the distance, and wild beasts fled!
Taking a deep breath, Wutian held his injured arm and watched coldly. Without stopping or taking action, Longhe ran into the dense forest. It was destined that the sheep would fall into the tiger's mouth and become the prey of the monster. This was what he deserved, and that was where he was buried.
The black ash on the ground has been washed away by the heavy rain, leaving only incomplete bones scattered on the ground. They are extremely eye-catching, as if telling the world that a tragedy happened here not long ago.
Xiaotian lay on his shoulder, rolled up her long wet tongue, and licked his face to comfort him.
"If your heart is trapped, the world will be a prison. If your heart is at ease, a small tiled room will also be a paradise."
Wu Tian muttered, he probably understood why Long He did all this. Once he had desires and did not get what he wanted, he became an unkind, unfaithful and unfilial person. This was all caused by greed and harming others and himself!
The storm invades!
At the entrance of the village, Wutian knelt on the ground, digging away one by one with his glowing hands. Three hours later, a five-foot deep pit appeared. This was the cemetery where he dug graves with his hands and buried the entire village.
With tears streaming down his face, his hair disheveled, he picked up the white bones, hand bones, leg bones, and the white and scary skulls, which seemed to be telling resentment, and placed them in the deep pit.
He limped and searched every corner, not missing even a scrap of bone, and put them all in.
He didn't differentiate between men and women, or who was who. These were all the people in the village. We were all one family. There was nothing wrong with being buried together. There was no need to differentiate!
In the end, he reluctantly put the complete white bones in, tears welling up in his eyes, and he couldn't let go in his heart. The grandfather who raised him in the 16th century and the villagers who lived with him in the 16th century were now returning to dust and dust to dust. He felt sad.
"Roar!!!"
At this time, the beasts in the back mountain roared, like the waves crashing on the shore, with lingering sounds, the ancient trees in the forest swaying, the rocks cracking, surging in all directions, and dust flying.
In the dust, dozens of ferocious beasts surrounded Long He. Their bloody mouths and stern fangs tore at his body, and pieces of flesh were torn off and devoured.
With a "bang", a monster beast shattered into pieces, and blood mist flew all over the sky. However, there were too many monster beasts. When they swarmed him, he was overwhelmed by the tide of beasts, and no matter how hard he struggled, it was in vain!
Thousands of miles away, flamingos soared at great speed. Huo Shi and Liu Yan stood proudly, their clothes making a hunting sound, looking down at the vast land.
Suddenly, Huo Shi's face turned pale, a wisp of blood overflowed from the corner of his mouth, and he became gloomy.
"Senior brother, what's wrong with you?" Liu Yan asked doubtfully.
Huo Shi was silent, looking at the distant polar regions. There was a mountain with a height of ten thousand feet, majestic and majestic. The mountain wall seemed to have been split by an axe. It was smooth and smooth. From a distance, it looked like a giant sword, towering into the sky. It was shocking!
On the mountain peak, a group of palaces are dotted with splendid momentum, and the Jade Yuqiong Tower is pierced into the mountain wall, showing its extraordinary appearance.
The white mist is long, the auspicious clouds are spraying thin, and the essence is rich. It is like a fairy mountain and a pure land on earth.
"Now is not the time to investigate the cause of Long He's death. The token has appeared, and we need to inform my father as soon as possible and ask him to make a decision." Huo Shi's face was as sinking as water, and he stamped his feet lightly. The flamingo screamed, and his speed suddenly surged, turning into a blaze of fire and rushing towards the mountain peak.
"Grandpa, fellow villagers, Long He is dead. He deserved it. He died in the belly of the monster. In the near future, it will be the turn of the culprit."
The loess is scattered on the white bones, gradually covering this place. Wutian's hands are trembling. There is too much reluctance in his heart, and there are too many things he wants to say, but his throat seems to be blocked by an inexplicable object, and he cannot say anything. Only blood and tears drip down, expressing his sorrow!
As the last handful of loess was sprinkled, the bones were completely buried, the living no longer existed, and the dead returned to dust. He knelt three times and kowtowed nine times to pay homage to the souls of the dead who died unjustly!
"Tian'er swears here that he will behead Liu Yan, the Fire World, and pay homage to everyone's souls. Rest in peace, everyone! "Wutian clenched his fists, and the crunching sounds continued to be heard. His tears were gone because they had dried up, and he elaborated on his promise.
Finally, he stood up and bowed, turned around with endless sadness, and disappeared into the mountains behind.
In this battle, Wutian was seriously injured. His arm was broken, his energy was exhausted, and his internal organs were injured. He had to go into the back mountain to recuperate.
Soon, he found a cave where there was a mountain ape. When he saw a human trying to occupy his nest, he angrily attacked him, but his throat was bitten by Xiaotian and he fell to the ground dead.
In the next few days, Wutian sat cross-legged in the cave, while Xiaotian hunted outside and extracted essence for him to use for healing.
Although Xiaotian is small in size, his attack power is really not bad. There is no monster in this mountain range that is his opponent, and he is killed one by one!
